title.zh: 轴对称 Picard 磁通 Green 更新

summary: Convert toroidal current density to cell currents, apply a dense cell-current-to-flux Green matrix, relax the resulting flux against the previous state, and report relative flux/current changes. The complete result is returned as one scirel._result.Result mapping; mapping access is retained and every field also supports attribute access. No nested mapping is wrapped.

capability: Convert toroidal current density to cell currents, apply a dense Green matrix and relax the resulting flux.
operation: R-Z grid, J_phi, prior and vacuum flux, Green matrix and relax -> next flux, cell currents and relative changes
discovery.model: One axisymmetric dense-Green Picard step with flux relaxation, not current relaxation.
discovery.geometry: Rectilinear cylindrical R-Z grid with at least three nodes per axis; [Z,R] arrays and C-order Green flattening.
discovery.boundary: Quadrature uses the declared input node domain or explicit cell boundaries; no implicit exterior support is invented.

identity.relation: toroidal current-density grid and dense Green response to one relaxed axisymmetric flux update
identity.direction: R-Z grid, J_phi, previous/vacuum flux, Green matrix and relax -> psi_next, cell currents and relative changes
identity.definition: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current. Form candidate=psi_vac+G_psi@I and psi_next=relax*psi_state+(1-relax)*candidate. Return relaxed step change, raw-current change, and unrelaxed fixed-point residual.
identity.model: one axisymmetric dense-Green Picard step with flux relaxation, not current relaxation
identity.geometry: rectilinear cylindrical R-Z grid with at least three nodes per axis
identity.coordinates: [Z,R] arrays; Green rows and columns follow C-order field-point and cell-current flattening
identity.boundary: Quadrature uses the declared input node domain or explicit cell boundaries; no implicit exterior support is invented.
assumptions: relax is the weight of the previous flux, not a mixer for current values.

Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.

Both psi and the Green flux response use the R A_phi convention in Wb/rad; the actual toroidal equation does not include 2*pi, the legacy Wb labels in the vacuum-field/superposition chain are corrected, and no numerical value is changed.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative, rectilinear and strictly increasing radial axis; at least three columns.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.constraints: Rectilinear and strictly increasing axial axis; at least three rows and same shape as r_grid.

inputs.name: j_phi
inputs.description: Caller-selected toroidal current density at each grid cell.
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the grid; this Operator does not apply a plasma mask.

inputs.name: psi_state
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the grid; used for flux relaxation and relative change.

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum or external psi=R A_phi contribution.
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the grid and aligned with Green response rows.

inputs.name: g_psi
inputs.constraints: Finite square matrix with field-point rows and source-current columns in [Z,R] C order.

inputs.name: relax
inputs.constraints: Finite and 0 <= relax < 1; one is rejected.

inputs.name: previous_cell_currents
inputs.description: Previous raw cell-current array used only for the current-change diagnostic.
inputs.constraints: If omitted or null, compare against zeros; otherwise exactly match the grid shape.

inputs.name: cell_edges
inputs.description: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.
inputs.dtype: pair of finite arrays or None
inputs.constraints: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.

outputs.name: psi_next
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Flux-relaxed next total psi=R A_phi state.

outputs.name: plasma_cell_currents
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Terminal or step current density integrated with the explicitly declared node/cell-domain weights.
outputs.constraints: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.

outputs.name: relative_psi_change
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: L2 norm of psi_next-psi_state divided by max(||psi_next||,||psi_vac||,tiny).
outputs.constraints: Uses the returned psi_next and the previous psi_state.

outputs.name: relative_current_change
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: L2 norm of raw currents minus prior currents divided by max(||raw currents||,1).
outputs.constraints: Previous currents affect this diagnostic only, not the flux update.

outputs.name: fixed_point_residual
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Norm(candidate-psi_state)/max(norm(candidate),norm(psi_vac),tiny); independent of relax.

preconditions: The caller supplies a physically meaningful J_phi and a Green matrix in the stated cell-current/field-point convention.
All grid fields are same-shape finite arrays and g_psi has the exact dense square shape.
supported: One finite R-Z axisymmetric flux-feedback step with caller-selected current, external flux and flux-relaxation weight.
excluded: A complete converged equilibrium or automatic selection of iteration count.
Current relaxation, automatic active-cell masking, or automatic conversion to complete linked flux 2*pi*psi.
Non-axisymmetric geometry, sparse-Green optimization, or a guarantee of finite arithmetic for all extreme finite inputs.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for wrong-rank, mismatched or nonfinite grid fields; negative/nonincreasing/nonrectilinear or too-small grids; invalid Green matrix; relax outside [0,1); or invalid previous currents.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Unexpected NumPy arithmetic failures propagate. Intermediate overflow in matrix multiplication or norm evaluation is not separately trapped by a finite-output guard.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable to one step; the caller controls and checks the iteration loop.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No scirel._result.Result mapping is returned after an exception; no nested Result is introduced.

python.signature: update_axisymmetric_picard_flux(r_grid, z_grid, j_phi, psi_state, psi_vac, g_psi, relax, previous_cell_currents=None, *, cell_edges=None)

example.description: A nonuniform node-domain integral has exact linear current total; the named result also preserves mapping and attribute access.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel._result import Result
from scirel.equilibrium import update_axisymmetric_picard_flux
r,z=np.meshgrid([1.,1.2,2.],[-.4,-.1,.4])
out=update_axisymmetric_picard_flux(r,z,r,r*0,r*0,np.zeros((9,9)),0.)
assert isinstance(out, Result)
assert out.plasma_cell_currents is out['plasma_cell_currents']
np.testing.assert_allclose(out.plasma_cell_currents.sum(),1.2,rtol=1e-14,atol=1e-14)
example.expected: 1.2 A over exactly the supplied node domain. The returned object is a scirel._result.Result mapping; every field is also readable as an attribute.

scope: Linear J=R integrates to 1.2 A on a nonuniform [1,2] by [-0.4,0.4] node domain.
Compact polynomial current converges to 8/225 A on nonuniform grids.
Explicit uniform cell edges reproduce the full-area center convention.
Return-type regression checks the top-level scirel._result.Result, key order and attribute access while retaining the existing numerical, state and failure assertions.
